title: 孔乙己
author: 鲁迅 (Lu Xun)
sourceEdition: 《孔乙己》(1919), abridged retelling; classical text on Chinese Wikisource

premise.en: At the Xianheng tavern in a small Chinese town, a poor, old-fashioned scholar named Kong Yiji becomes a figure of mockery, pity, and finally tragedy.
premise.zh-Hans: 在中国一个小镇的咸亨酒店里，一个贫穷、迂腐的读书人孔乙己，成了大家嘲笑、同情，最终又令人悲伤的人物。

summary.en: Told through the eyes of a boy who works at the Xianheng tavern warming wine, this story follows Kong Yiji, a poor scholar who still wears a long gown out of pride even though he cannot pass the exams or hold a job. Mocked for stealing and for his old-fashioned speech, he still shows unexpected kindness to children, but his troubles slowly grow worse until he disappears from the tavern for good.
summary.zh-Hans: 故事通过一个在咸亨酒店温酒的男孩的眼睛，讲述了孔乙己的故事。他是一个贫穷的读书人，虽然没有通过科举考试，也没有正式的工作，却仍然骄傲地穿着长衫。他因偷东西和说话迂腐常常被人嘲笑，却对孩子们表现出意想不到的善意，但他的处境渐渐变得更糟，最终从酒店里永远消失了。

tutorNotes.pronunciation: Point out the retroflex initials zh/ch/sh in words like 之乎者也 (zhī hū zhě yě), 掌柜 (zhǎngguì) and 窃书 (qiè shū); these sounds are made with the tongue curled back, unlike English 'j' or 'ch'. The neutral tone in 伙计 (huǒji) and 茴香豆 (huíxiāngdòu) should stay light and unstressed. Remember that 一 changes tone before a falling-tone syllable, as in 一颗 (yì kē).
tutorNotes.grammar: The text uses 了 to mark completed actions, such as 打断了 (broke) and 死了 (died), alongside 是……的 constructions to highlight how or when something happened. Simple relative clauses built with 的 are frequent, as in 温酒的伙计 (the boy who warms wine). Note the negative pattern 不能算 (cannot be considered), used in Kong Yiji's famous defense of himself.
tutorNotes.culture: Before China's imperial examination system ended, passing it could bring a scholar wealth and status, symbolized by the long gown (长衫) that separated the educated from laborers in short jackets. A person like Kong Yiji, who never passed the exams but refuses to give up the gown, became a tragic symbol of a dying social order. Lu Xun wrote this story in 1919 to criticize how society mocked and abandoned people like him instead of helping them.
tutorNotes.commonErrors: Learners often confuse 不 and 没 for negation: 不 negates habits, opinions, or the future, while 没(有) negates completed past events, as in 没有再来 (did not come again). Another common mistake is reading a fixed phrase like 之乎者也 word by word instead of treating it as one unit meaning 'old-fashioned bookish talk'. Watch also for 把 in 把兔子带回家-style sentences, which moves the object before the verb.

question.en: Who works at the Xianheng tavern, and what is his job?
question.zh-Hans: 谁在咸亨酒店当伙计，他负责做什么工作？

question.en: How is Kong Yiji different from the other customers at the tavern?
question.zh-Hans: 孔乙己和酒店里的其他客人有什么不同？

question.en: What famous line does Kong Yiji say when people accuse him of stealing?
question.zh-Hans: 当别人指责孔乙己偷东西时，他说了哪句有名的话？

question.en: How did Kong Yiji's legs get broken?
question.zh-Hans: 孔乙己的腿是怎么打断的？

question.en: Why might the story's last line use the contradictory phrase "probably... indeed" (大约的确)?
question.zh-Hans: 为什么故事的最后一句话要用“大约……的确”这样看似矛盾的说法？

sentences.text: 我十二岁的时候，在鲁镇的咸亨酒店当伙计。

translation.en: When I was twelve years old, I worked as a waiter at the Xianheng Wine Shop in Luzhen.
translation.fr: Quand j'avais douze ans, j'étais serveur à l'auberge Xianheng de la ville de Lu.
translation.es: Cuando tenía doce años, trabajaba como mozo en la taberna Xianheng del pueblo de Lu.
translation.pt: Quando eu tinha doze anos, trabalhei como empregado na taverna Xianheng, na cidade de Lu.
translation.it: Quando avevo dodici anni, lavoravo come garzone nella taverna Xianheng di Luzhen.
translation.zh-Hans: 我十二岁的时候，在鲁镇的咸亨酒店当伙计。
translation.zh-Hant: 我十二歲的時候，在魯鎮的咸亨酒店當夥計。
translation.ro: Când aveam doisprezece ani, lucram ca băiat la hanul Xianheng din orașul Lu.
translation.ca: Quan tenia dotze anys, treballava com a mosso a la taverna Xianheng del poble de Lu.

sentences.text: 我的工作很简单，就是每天给客人温酒。

translation.en: My job was simple: every day I warmed wine for the customers.
translation.fr: Mon travail était très simple : chaque jour, je devais chauffer le vin pour les clients.
translation.es: Mi trabajo era muy simple: todos los días calentaba vino para los clientes.
translation.pt: Meu trabalho era simples: todos os dias eu esquentava vinho para os clientes.
translation.it: Il mio lavoro era molto semplice: ogni giorno dovevo scaldare il vino per i clienti.
translation.zh-Hans: 我的工作很简单，就是每天给客人温酒。
translation.zh-Hant: 我的工作很簡單，就是每天給客人溫酒。
translation.ro: Munca mea era simplă: în fiecare zi încălzeam vinul pentru clienți.
translation.ca: La meva feina era molt senzilla: cada dia escalfava vi per als clients.

sentences.text: 咸亨酒店的客人分成两种，很容易分辨。

translation.en: The customers at Xianheng Wine Shop were divided into two types, easy to tell apart.
translation.fr: Les clients de l'auberge Xianheng se divisaient en deux catégories, faciles à distinguer.
translation.es: Los clientes de la taberna Xianheng se dividían en dos tipos, fáciles de distinguir.
translation.pt: Os clientes da taverna Xianheng se dividiam em dois tipos, fáceis de distinguir.
translation.it: I clienti della taverna Xianheng erano di due tipi, facili da distinguere.
translation.zh-Hans: 咸亨酒店的客人分成两种，很容易分辨。
translation.zh-Hant: 咸亨酒店的客人分成兩種，很容易分辨。
translation.ro: Clienții hanului Xianheng erau de două feluri, ușor de deosebit.
translation.ca: Els clients de la taverna Xianheng es dividien en dos tipus, fàcils de distingir.

sentences.text: 穿长衫的客人坐在里面的房间，慢慢地喝酒吃菜。

translation.en: Those in long gowns sat in the inner room, slowly drinking wine and eating dishes.
translation.fr: Les clients en robe longue s'asseyaient dans la salle intérieure, buvant et mangeant lentement.
translation.es: Los que vestían túnicas largas se sentaban en la sala interior, bebiendo vino y comiendo platos lentamente.
translation.pt: Os que vestiam roupas compridas sentavam-se na sala dos fundos, bebendo e comendo devagar.
translation.it: Quelli che indossavano la veste lunga sedevano nella stanza interna, bevendo vino e mangiando piatti lentamente.
translation.zh-Hans: 穿长衫的客人坐在里面的房间，慢慢地喝酒吃菜。
translation.zh-Hant: 穿長衫的客人坐在裡面的房間，慢慢地喝酒吃菜。
translation.ro: Cei care purtau robe lungi stăteau în camera dinăuntru, bând și mâncând încet.
translation.ca: Els que portaven túnica llarga seien a la sala interior, bevent vi i menjant plats a poc a poc.

sentences.text: 穿短衣的客人只能站在柜台外面，喝一碗便宜的酒。

translation.en: Those in short jackets could only stand outside the counter, drinking a cheap bowl of wine.
translation.fr: Les clients en veste courte devaient rester debout devant le comptoir, buvant un bol de vin bon marché.
translation.es: Los que vestían ropa corta solo podían estar de pie fuera del mostrador, bebiendo un tazón de vino barato.
translation.pt: Os que vestiam roupas curtas só podiam ficar em pé do lado de fora do balcão, bebendo uma tigela de vinho barato.
translation.it: Quelli che indossavano la giacca corta potevano solo stare in piedi fuori dal bancone e bere una ciotola di vino a buon mercato.
translation.zh-Hans: 穿短衣的客人只能站在柜台外面，喝一碗便宜的酒。
translation.zh-Hant: 穿短衣的客人只能站在櫃檯外面，喝一碗便宜的酒。
translation.ro: Cei care purtau haine scurte stăteau afară, lângă tejghea, și beau un castron de vin ieftin.
translation.ca: Els que portaven roba curta només podien estar davant del taulell, bevent un bol de vi barat.

sentences.text: 只有孔乙己是个例外，他也穿长衫，却只能站着喝酒。

translation.en: Only Kong Yiji was an exception: he also wore a long gown, but he had to stand and drink.
translation.fr: Seul Kong Yiji faisait exception : il portait aussi une robe longue, mais devait boire debout.
translation.es: Solo Kong Yiji era una excepción: también vestía túnica larga, pero solo podía beber de pie.
translation.pt: Só Kong Yiji era uma exceção: ele também vestia roupas compridas, mas só podia beber em pé.
translation.it: Solo Kong Yiji faceva eccezione: anche lui indossava la veste lunga, ma doveva bere in piedi.
translation.zh-Hans: 只有孔乙己是个例外，他也穿长衫，却只能站着喝酒。
translation.zh-Hant: 只有孔乙己是個例外，他也穿長衫，卻只能站著喝酒。
translation.ro: Doar Kong Yiji era o excepție: și el purta robă lungă, dar stătea în picioare să bea.
translation.ca: Només Kong Yiji era una excepció: també portava túnica llarga, però havia de beure dempeus.

sentences.text: 我在咸亨酒店干了很久，渐渐觉得这份工作十分无聊。

translation.en: I worked at Xianheng Wine Shop for a long time, and gradually found the job very boring.
translation.fr: J'avais travaillé longtemps à l'auberge Xianheng, et peu à peu, je trouvais ce travail très ennuyeux.
translation.es: Trabajé en la taberna Xianheng durante mucho tiempo, y poco a poco sentí que este trabajo era muy aburrido.
translation.pt: Trabalhei na taverna Xianheng por muito tempo e, aos poucos, comecei a achar o trabalho muito chato.
translation.it: Lavorai alla taverna Xianheng per molto tempo, e a poco a poco trovai quel lavoro molto noioso.
translation.zh-Hans: 我在咸亨酒店干了很久，渐渐觉得这份工作十分无聊。
translation.zh-Hant: 我在咸亨酒店幹了很久，漸漸覺得這份工作十分無聊。
translation.ro: Am lucrat mult timp la hanul Xianheng și, încet-încet, am început să mă plictisesc de această slujbă.
translation.ca: Vaig treballar molt de temps a la taverna Xianheng i a poc a poc vaig trobar aquella feina molt avorrida.

sentences.text: 掌柜见我老实，本来想让我专门伺候那些穿长衫的客人。

translation.en: The manager saw that I was honest, and originally wanted me to serve those customers in long gowns.
translation.fr: Le patron, voyant que j'étais honnête, avait d'abord voulu me charger spécialement de servir les clients en robe longue.
translation.es: El dueño, al verme honesto, al principio quiso que atendiera especialmente a esos clientes de túnica larga.
translation.pt: O gerente, vendo que eu era honesto, a princípio quis me designar para servir especialmente os clientes de roupas compridas.
translation.it: Il padrone, vedendo che ero onesto, all'inizio voleva farmi servire apposta quei clienti con la veste lunga.
translation.zh-Hans: 掌柜见我老实，本来想让我专门伺候那些穿长衫的客人。
translation.zh-Hant: 掌櫃見我老實，本來想讓我專門伺候那些穿長衫的客人。
translation.ro: Patronul, văzând că sunt cinstit, a vrut să mă pună să servesc doar clienții cu robe lungi.
translation.ca: El gerent, com que em veia honest, al principi volia que servís especialment els clients de túnica llarga.

sentences.text: 可是我总是做得不好，掌柜说我不够圆滑，脸上不会堆笑。

translation.en: But I never did well; the manager said I wasn't smooth enough, and didn't know how to put on a smile.
translation.fr: Mais je n'y arrivais jamais bien ; le patron disait que je n'étais pas assez habile, que je ne savais pas sourire.
translation.es: Pero yo siempre lo hacía mal; el dueño decía que no era lo bastante diplomático, que no sabía poner una sonrisa en la cara.
translation.pt: Mas eu nunca fazia bem o serviço; o gerente dizia que eu não era flexível e não sabia sorrir com falsidade.
translation.it: Ma non ci riuscivo mai bene; il padrone diceva che non ero abbastanza diplomatico, che non sapevo mettere un sorriso finto sul viso.
translation.zh-Hans: 可是我总是做得不好，掌柜说我不够圆滑，脸上不会堆笑。
translation.zh-Hant: 可是我總是做得不好，掌櫃說我不夠圓滑，臉上不會堆笑。
translation.ro: Dar nu mă descurcam bine; patronul spunea că nu sunt destul de isteț și că nu știu să zâmbesc prefăcut.
translation.ca: Però jo no ho feia bé mai; el gerent deia que no era prou astut i que no posava cara de somriure.

sentences.text: 后来，掌柜就让我专门负责温酒这一件简单的事情。

translation.en: Later, the manager assigned me to the simple task of warming wine.
translation.fr: Plus tard, le patron me confia uniquement la tâche simple de chauffer le vin.
translation.es: Después, el dueño me encargó únicamente la tarea simple de calentar el vino.
translation.pt: Depois, o gerente me encarregou apenas da tarefa simples de esquentar vinho.
translation.it: Più tardi, il padrone mi fece occupare solo di quella semplice faccenda di scaldare il vino.
translation.zh-Hans: 后来，掌柜就让我专门负责温酒这一件简单的事情。
translation.zh-Hant: 後來，掌櫃就讓我專門負責溫酒這一件簡單的事情。
translation.ro: Apoi, patronul m-a pus să mă ocup doar de încălzitul vinului, o treabă simplă.
translation.ca: Després, el gerent em va fer encarregar només de la tasca senzilla d'escalfar vi.

sentences.text: 每天从早到晚，我站在柜台里，机械地重复着同样的动作。

translation.en: Every day from morning to night, I stood behind the counter, mechanically repeating the same motions.
translation.fr: Chaque jour, du matin au soir, je restais debout derrière le comptoir, répétant mécaniquement les mêmes gestes.
translation.es: Cada día, de la mañana a la noche, me quedaba detrás del mostrador, repitiendo mecánicamente los mismos movimientos.
translation.pt: Todos os dias, de manhã à noite, eu ficava atrás do balcão, repetindo mecanicamente os mesmos movimentos.
translation.it: Ogni giorno dall'alba al tramonto, stavo dietro il bancone e ripetevo meccanicamente gli stessi gesti.
translation.zh-Hans: 每天从早到晚，我站在柜台里，机械地重复着同样的动作。
translation.zh-Hant: 每天從早到晚，我站在櫃檯裡，機械地重複著同樣的動作。
translation.ro: În fiecare zi, de dimineață până seara, stăteam la tejghea și repetam aceleași mișcări mecanic.
translation.ca: Cada dia de matí a nit, estava darrere del taulell repetint mecànicament els mateixos moviments.

sentences.text: 只有孔乙己到店，才能让这间无聊的酒店热闹一点。

translation.en: Only when Kong Yiji came to the shop did the boring place liven up a bit.
translation.fr: Seul Kong Yiji, quand il venait, pouvait animer un peu cette auberge ennuyeuse.
translation.es: Solo cuando Kong Yiji llegaba a la taberna, este lugar aburrido se animaba un poco.
translation.pt: Só quando Kong Yiji vinha à taverna é que aquele lugar chato ficava um pouco mais animado.
translation.it: Solo quando arrivava Kong Yiji, quella taverna noiosa si animava un po'.
translation.zh-Hans: 只有孔乙己到店，才能让这间无聊的酒店热闹一点。
translation.zh-Hant: 只有孔乙己到店，才能讓這間無聊的酒店熱鬧一點。
translation.ro: Doar când venea Kong Yiji, hanul ăsta plictisitor devenea puțin mai vesel.
translation.ca: Només quan Kong Yiji venia a la taverna, aquest lloc avorrit s'animava una mica.

sentences.text: 所以每次听到孔乙己的声音，我心里反而有点高兴。

translation.en: So every time I heard Kong Yiji's voice, I felt a little happy inside.
translation.fr: Aussi, chaque fois que j'entendais la voix de Kong Yiji, j'étais en fait un peu content.
translation.es: Por eso, cada vez que oía la voz de Kong Yiji, en mi interior me sentía un poco contento.
translation.pt: Por isso, toda vez que eu ouvia a voz de Kong Yiji, sentia uma certa alegria no coração.
translation.it: Perciò ogni volta che sentivo la voce di Kong Yiji, in cuor mio ero un po' contento.
translation.zh-Hans: 所以每次听到孔乙己的声音，我心里反而有点高兴。
translation.zh-Hant: 所以每次聽到孔乙己的聲音，我心裡反而有點高興。
translation.ro: Așa că, de fiecare dată când auzeam vocea lui Kong Yiji, în sufletul meu mă bucuram.
translation.ca: Per això, cada vegada que sentia la veu de Kong Yiji, en el fons em sentia una mica content.

sentences.text: 孔乙己身材很高，脸色青白，脸上常常有伤疤。

translation.en: Kong Yiji was very tall, with a pale complexion, and often had scars on his face.
translation.fr: Kong Yiji était très grand, son visage était pâle, et il avait souvent des cicatrices.
translation.es: Kong Yiji era muy alto, de tez pálida, y a menudo tenía cicatrices en la cara.
translation.pt: Kong Yiji era muito alto, tinha o rosto pálido e frequentemente apresentava cicatrizes.
translation.it: Kong Yiji era molto alto, aveva il viso pallido e spesso portava cicatrici.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己身材很高，脸色青白，脸上常常有伤疤。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己身材很高，臉色青白，臉上常常有傷疤。
translation.ro: Kong Yiji era foarte înalt, cu fața palidă și adesea cu cicatrici.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji era molt alt, tenia la cara pàl·lida i sovint hi tenia cicatrius.

sentences.text: 他的长衫又脏又破，好像十几年没有洗过一样。

translation.en: His long gown was dirty and torn, as if it hadn't been washed in over ten years.
translation.fr: Sa robe longue était sale et déchirée, comme si elle n'avait pas été lavée depuis une dizaine d'années.
translation.es: Su túnica larga estaba sucia y rota, como si no la hubiera lavado en más de diez años.
translation.pt: Suas roupas compridas eram sujas e rasgadas, como se não fossem lavadas há mais de dez anos.
translation.it: La sua veste lunga era sporca e strappata, come se non fosse stata lavata da una decina d'anni.
translation.zh-Hans: 他的长衫又脏又破，好像十几年没有洗过一样。
translation.zh-Hant: 他的長衫又髒又破，好像十幾年沒有洗過一樣。
translation.ro: Roba lui era murdară și ruptă, de parcă n-ar fi fost spălată de zece ani.
translation.ca: La seva túnica llarga era bruta i esquinçada, com si no l'hagués rentat en deu anys.

sentences.text: 他说话总是满口之乎者也，别人常常听不懂。

translation.en: He always spoke with 'zhi hu zhe ye' (literary particles), and others often couldn't understand him.
translation.fr: Il parlait toujours avec des 'zhi hu zhe ye' (langage classique), et les autres ne comprenaient souvent pas.
translation.es: Siempre hablaba con muchas expresiones clásicas, y los demás a menudo no lo entendían.
translation.pt: Ele sempre falava cheio de expressões antigas e eruditas, e os outros muitas vezes não entendiam.
translation.it: Parlava sempre con un sacco di 'zhī hū zhě yě', e gli altri spesso non capivano.
translation.zh-Hans: 他说话总是满口之乎者也，别人常常听不懂。
translation.zh-Hant: 他說話總是滿口之乎者也，別人常常聽不懂。
translation.ro: Vorbea mereu cu expresii învechite, iar ceilalți de multe ori nu-l înțelegeau.
translation.ca: Sempre parlava amb un munt de 'zhi hu zhe ye' (paraules clàssiques) i sovint els altres no l'entenien.

sentences.text: 每次他一来，喝酒的人都会笑他，拿他开玩笑。

translation.en: Every time he came, the drinkers would laugh at him and make jokes about him.
translation.fr: Chaque fois qu'il venait, les buveurs se moquaient de lui et plaisantaient à ses dépens.
translation.es: Cada vez que él venía, los bebedores se reían de él y le gastaban bromas.
translation.pt: Toda vez que ele chegava, os bebedores caçoavam dele e faziam piadas.
translation.it: Ogni volta che arrivava, i bevitori lo prendevano in giro e scherzavano su di lui.
translation.zh-Hans: 每次他一来，喝酒的人都会笑他，拿他开玩笑。
translation.zh-Hant: 每次他來，喝酒的人都會笑他，拿他開玩笑。
translation.ro: De fiecare dată când venea, oamenii care beau râdeau de el și își băteau joc de el.
translation.ca: Cada vegada que venia, els qui bevien se'n reien i li feien bromes.

sentences.text: 镇上的孩子们也常常围着孔乙己，等着看他出丑取乐。

translation.en: The children in town also often gathered around Kong Yiji, waiting to see him make a fool of himself for fun.
translation.fr: Les enfants du village aussi s'attroupaient souvent autour de Kong Yiji, attendant de le voir se ridiculiser pour s'amuser.
translation.es: Los niños del pueblo también solían rodear a Kong Yiji, esperando verlo hacer el ridículo para divertirse.
translation.pt: As crianças da cidade também costumavam cercar Kong Yiji, esperando vê-lo passar vergonha para se divertir.
translation.it: Anche i bambini del paese spesso gli si radunavano intorno, aspettando di vederlo fare brutta figura per divertirsi.
translation.zh-Hans: 镇上的孩子们也常常围着孔乙己，等着看他出丑取乐。
translation.zh-Hant: 鎮上的孩子們也常常圍著孔乙己，等著看他出醜取樂。
translation.ro: Și copiii din oraș se adunau adesea în jurul lui Kong Yiji, așteptând să-l vadă făcându-se de râs.
translation.ca: Els nens del poble també sovint envoltaven Kong Yiji, esperant veure'l fer el ridícul per divertir-se.

sentences.text: 孔乙己对大人的嘲笑毫不在意，却唯独对孩子们特别耐心。

translation.en: Kong Yiji didn't care about the adults' mockery, but he was especially patient with the children.
translation.fr: Kong Yiji ne prêtait pas attention aux moqueries des adultes, mais il était particulièrement patient avec les enfants.
translation.es: Kong Yiji no le daba importancia a las burlas de los adultos, pero era especialmente paciente con los niños.
translation.pt: Kong Yiji não ligava para as zombarias dos adultos, mas era especialmente paciente com as crianças.
translation.it: Kong Yiji non badava alle risate degli adulti, ma era particolarmente paziente con i bambini.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己对大人的嘲笑毫不在意，却唯独对孩子们特别耐心。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己對大人的嘲笑毫不在意，卻唯獨對孩子們特別耐心。
translation.ro: Kong Yiji nu băga în seamă râsul adulților, dar era deosebit de răbdător cu copiii.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji no feia cas de les rialles dels adults, però amb els nens era especialment pacient.

sentences.text: 有人问他：“孔乙己，你脸上又添新伤疤了！”

translation.en: Someone asked him, "Kong Yiji, you've got new scars on your face again!"
translation.fr: Quelqu'un lui demanda : "Kong Yiji, tu as encore de nouvelles cicatrices sur le visage !"
translation.es: Alguien le preguntó: "Kong Yiji, ¡tienes nuevas cicatrices en la cara!"
translation.pt: Alguém perguntou: "Kong Yiji, você ganhou novas cicatrizes no rosto!"
translation.it: Qualcuno gli chiese: "Kong Yiji, hai di nuovo nuove cicatrici sul viso!"
translation.zh-Hans: 有人问他：“孔乙己，你脸上又添新伤疤了！”
translation.zh-Hant: 有人問他：「孔乙己，你臉上又添新傷疤了！」
translation.ro: Cineva l-a întrebat: "Kong Yiji, ai iarăși o cicatrice nouă pe față!"
translation.ca: Algú li preguntava: "Kong Yiji, tens una altra cicatriu nova a la cara!"

sentences.text: 孔乙己不回答，只是涨红了脸，喝一口酒不说话。

translation.en: Kong Yiji didn't answer, just flushed red, took a sip of wine, and said nothing.
translation.fr: Kong Yiji did not answer, but his face turned red, and he took a sip of wine without speaking.
translation.es: Kong Yiji didn't answer, just turned red in the face, took a sip of wine, and said nothing.
translation.pt: 孔乙己 didn't answer, just flushed red, took a sip of wine and said nothing.
translation.it: Kong Yiji didn't answer, just blushed, took a sip of wine, and said nothing.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己不回答，只是涨红了脸，喝一口酒不说话。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己不回答，只是漲紅了臉，喝一口酒不說話。
translation.ro: 孔乙己 nu răspunde, doar își înroșește fața, bea o gură de vin și nu vorbește.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji no va respondre, només es va posar vermell, va beure un glop de vi i no va dir res.

sentences.text: 又有人大声问：“你一定又偷了别人的东西吧！”

translation.en: Someone else asked loudly, "You must have stolen someone else's things again!"
translation.fr: Someone else asked loudly, "You must have stolen someone else's things again!"
translation.es: Someone else asked loudly, "You must have stolen someone else's things again!"
translation.pt: Someone else loudly asked: "You must have stolen someone else's things again!"
translation.it: Someone else asked loudly: "You must have stolen someone else's things again!"
translation.zh-Hans: 又有人大声问：“你一定又偷了别人的东西吧！”
translation.zh-Hant: 又有人大聲問：「你一定又偷了別人的東西吧！」
translation.ro: Altcineva întreabă cu voce tare: „Sigur ai furat din nou lucrurile altora, nu-i așa?”
translation.ca: Algú altre va preguntar en veu alta: "Segur que has robat una altra vegada les coses dels altres!"

sentences.text: 孔乙己睁大眼睛说：“你怎么这样凭空污人清白……”

translation.en: Kong Yiji opened his eyes wide and said, "How can you slander an innocent man like this..."
translation.fr: Kong Yiji opened his eyes wide and said, "How can you slander an innocent person like this..."
translation.es: Kong Yiji opened his eyes wide and said, "How can you slander an innocent person like this..."
translation.pt: 孔乙己 opened his eyes wide and said: "How can you slander an innocent person like this..."
translation.it: Kong Yiji opened his eyes wide and said: "How can you slander an innocent person like this..."
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己睁大眼睛说：“你怎么这样凭空污人清白……”
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己睜大眼睛說：「你怎麼這樣憑空污人清白……」
translation.ro: 孔乙己 deschide ochii mari și spune: „Cum poți să calomniezi așa, fără dovezi...”
translation.ca: Kong Yiji va obrir els ulls de bat a bat i va dir: "Com pots tacar la innocència d'algú així, sense cap motiu..."

sentences.text: 别人又笑着问：“上次明明看见你偷了何家的书！”

translation.en: Others laughed and asked, "Last time we clearly saw you steal the He family's books!"
translation.fr: Others laughed and asked, "Last time we clearly saw you steal the He family's books!"
translation.es: Others laughed and asked, "Last time we clearly saw you steal the He family's books!"
translation.pt: Others laughed and asked: "Last time we clearly saw you steal the He family's books!"
translation.it: Others asked with a laugh: "Last time we clearly saw you steal the He family's books!"
translation.zh-Hans: 别人又笑着问：“上次明明看见你偷了何家的书！”
translation.zh-Hant: 別人又笑著問：「上次明明看見你偷了何家的書！」
translation.ro: Alții întreabă râzând: „Data trecută te-am văzut clar furând cărțile familiei He!”
translation.ca: Els altres van preguntar rient: "L'altre dia et vam veure clarament robant els llibres de la família He!"

sentences.text: 孔乙己脸上的红色慢慢散开，涨得更红了。

translation.en: The red on Kong Yiji's face slowly spread, turning even redder.
translation.fr: The redness on Kong Yiji's face slowly spread, turning even redder.
translation.es: The red on Kong Yiji's face slowly spread, turning even redder.
translation.pt: The red on 孔乙己's face slowly spread, turning even redder.
translation.it: The red on Kong Yiji's face slowly spread, turning even redder.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己脸上的红色慢慢散开，涨得更红了。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己臉上的紅色慢慢散開，漲得更紅了。
translation.ro: Roșeața de pe fața lui 孔乙己 se răspândește încet, devenind și mai roșie.
translation.ca: El vermell de la cara de Kong Yiji es va anar escampant a poc a poc, i es va posar encara més vermell.

sentences.text: 他低声说：“窃书不能算偷……窃书！……读书人的事，能算偷吗？”

translation.en: He said in a low voice, "Borrowing books can't be considered stealing... Borrowing books!... Can the affairs of a scholar be considered stealing?"
translation.fr: He said in a low voice, "Borrowing books cannot be considered stealing... Borrowing books!... Can the affairs of a scholar be considered stealing?"
translation.es: He said in a low voice, "Taking books can't be considered stealing... Taking books!... Can the affairs of a scholar be considered stealing?"
translation.pt: He said in a low voice: "Borrowing books can't be considered stealing... Borrowing books!... Can the affairs of a scholar be considered stealing?"
translation.it: He said in a low voice: "Borrowing books can't be considered stealing... Borrowing books!... Can the affairs of a scholar be considered stealing?"
translation.zh-Hans: 他低声说：“窃书不能算偷……窃书！……读书人的事，能算偷吗？”
translation.zh-Hant: 他低聲說：「竊書不能算偷……竊書！……讀書人的事，能算偷嗎？」
translation.ro: El spune cu voce scăzută: „Furtul de cărți nu poate fi considerat furt... Furtul de cărți!... Afacerile oamenilor cărturari pot fi considerate furt?”
translation.ca: Va dir en veu baixa: "Robar llibres no es pot considerar robar... Robar llibres!... Els assumptes dels homes de lletres, es poden considerar robatori?"

sentences.text: 接着他说了一串别人听不懂的话，引得大家哄堂大笑。

translation.en: Then he said a string of words that others couldn't understand, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
translation.fr: Then he said a string of words that others could not understand, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
translation.es: Then he said a string of words that others couldn't understand, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
translation.pt: Then he said a string of words that others couldn't understand, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
translation.it: Then he said a string of words that others couldn't understand, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
translation.zh-Hans: 接着他说了一串别人听不懂的话，引得大家哄堂大笑。
translation.zh-Hant: 接著他說了一串別人聽不懂的話，引得大家哄堂大笑。
translation.ro: Apoi rostește o serie de cuvinte pe care ceilalți nu le înțeleg, stârnind râsete puternice din partea tuturor.
translation.ca: Després va dir una sèrie de paraules que ningú no entenia, cosa que va provocar rialles generals.

sentences.text: 柜台里外充满了快活的空气，只有孔乙己一个人显得孤单。

translation.en: Inside and outside the counter was filled with cheerful atmosphere, only Kong Yiji seemed lonely.
translation.fr: Inside and outside the counter was filled with cheerful atmosphere, only Kong Yiji appeared lonely.
translation.es: Inside and outside the counter was filled with cheerful atmosphere, only Kong Yiji seemed lonely.
translation.pt: Inside and outside the counter was filled with cheerful atmosphere, only 孔乙己 seemed lonely.
translation.it: Inside and outside the counter was filled with cheerful air, only Kong Yiji seemed lonely.
translation.zh-Hans: 柜台里外充满了快活的空气，只有孔乙己一个人显得孤单。
translation.zh-Hant: 櫃台裡外充滿了快活的空氣，只有孔乙己一個人顯得孤單。
translation.ro: Înăuntru și în afara tejghelei aerul este plin de veselie, doar 孔乙己 pare singur.
translation.ca: Dins i fora del taulell hi havia una atmosfera alegre, només Kong Yiji semblava sol.

sentences.text: 虽然大家常常笑他，孔乙己对我这个小伙计却很和气。

translation.en: Although everyone often laughed at him, Kong Yiji was very kind to me, the young apprentice.
translation.fr: Although everyone often laughed at him, Kong Yiji was very kind to me, the young apprentice.
translation.es: Although everyone often laughed at him, Kong Yiji was very kind to me, the little apprentice.
translation.pt: Although everyone often laughed at him, 孔乙己 was very kind to me, the young apprentice.
translation.it: Although everyone often laughed at him, Kong Yiji was very kind to me, the little apprentice.
translation.zh-Hans: 虽然大家常常笑他，孔乙己对我这个小伙计却很和气。
translation.zh-Hant: 雖然大家常常笑他，孔乙己對我這個小夥計卻很和氣。
translation.ro: Deși toți râd adesea de el, 孔乙己 este foarte amabil cu mine, ucenicul.
translation.ca: Tot i que tothom sovint se'n reia, Kong Yiji era molt amable amb mi, el jove aprenent.

chapters.title: 第二章 茴香豆的四种写法

sentences.text: 有一天，孔乙己问我：“你读过书吗？”

translation.en: One day, Kong Yiji asked me, "Have you studied?"
translation.fr: One day, Kong Yiji asked me, "Have you studied?"
translation.es: One day, Kong Yiji asked me, "Have you studied?"
translation.pt: One day, 孔乙己 asked me: "Have you studied?"
translation.it: One day, Kong Yiji asked me: "Have you studied?"
translation.zh-Hans: 有一天，孔乙己问我：“你读过书吗？”
translation.zh-Hant: 有一天，孔乙己問我：「你讀過書嗎？」
translation.ro: Într-o zi, 孔乙己 mă întreabă: „Ai citit cărți?”
translation.ca: Un dia, Kong Yiji em va preguntar: "Has estudiat?"

sentences.text: 我点点头，说：“读过一点。”

translation.en: I nodded and said, "A little."
translation.fr: I nodded and said, "A little."
translation.es: I nodded and said, "A little."
translation.pt: I nodded and said: "A little."
translation.it: I nodded and said: "A little."
translation.zh-Hans: 我点点头，说：“读过一点。”
translation.zh-Hant: 我點點頭，說：「讀過一點。」
translation.ro: Dau din cap și spun: „Am citit puțin.”
translation.ca: Vaig assentir amb el cap i vaig dir: "N'he estudiat una mica."

sentences.text: 他说：“那我考考你，茴香豆的茴字，怎么写？”

translation.en: He said, "Then let me test you: how do you write the character 'hui' in fennel beans?"
translation.fr: He said, "Then let me test you. How do you write the character 'hui' in fennel beans?"
translation.es: He said, "Then let me test you. How do you write the character 'hui' in fennel beans?"
translation.pt: He said: "Then let me test you, how do you write the character 'hui' in fennel beans?"
translation.it: He said: "Then let me test you. How do you write the character 'hui' in fennel beans?"
translation.zh-Hans: 他说：“那我考考你，茴香豆的茴字，怎么写？”
translation.zh-Hant: 他說：「那我考考你，茴香豆的茴字，怎麼寫？」
translation.ro: El spune: „Atunci hai să te testez: cum se scrie caracterul „hui” din „hui xiang dou” (anason)?
translation.ca: Ell va dir: "Doncs et posaré a prova, com s'escriu el caràcter 'hui' de 'hui xiang dou'?"

sentences.text: 我心里觉得他很可笑，一个乞讨的人也配考我。

translation.en: I thought he was ridiculous; a beggar like him was not qualified to test me.
translation.fr: I thought he was ridiculous; a beggar like him was not qualified to test me.
translation.es: I thought he was ridiculous; a beggar like him was not worthy to test me.
translation.pt: I thought he was ridiculous, a beggar also worthy to test me.
translation.it: I thought he was ridiculous; a beggar like him was not worthy to test me.
translation.zh-Hans: 我心里觉得他很可笑，一个乞讨的人也配考我。
translation.zh-Hant: 我心裡覺得他很可笑，一個乞討的人也配考我。
translation.ro: În gândul meu îl consider ridicol; un cerșetor cum îndrăznește să mă testeze?
translation.ca: Al meu interior vaig pensar que era molt ridícul, que un captaire també es permetia posar-me a prova.

sentences.text: 我转过身，不再理他，孔乙己等了许久，只好叹一口气。

translation.en: I turned around and ignored him. Kong Yiji waited for a long time, then had to sigh.
translation.fr: I turned around and ignored him. Kong Yiji waited for a long time, then had to sigh.
translation.es: I turned around and ignored him. Kong Yiji waited for a long time, then had to sigh.
translation.pt: I turned around and ignored him. 孔乙己 waited for a long time, then had to sigh.
translation.it: I turned around and ignored him. Kong Yiji waited for a long time, then had to sigh.
translation.zh-Hans: 我转过身，不再理他，孔乙己等了许久，只好叹一口气。
translation.zh-Hant: 我轉過身，不再理他，孔乙己等了許久，只好嘆一口氣。
translation.ro: Mă întorc și nu-i mai dau atenție. 孔乙己 așteaptă mult timp, apoi doar oftează.
translation.ca: Em vaig girar i ja no li vaig fer cas. Kong Yiji va esperar una bona estona i finalment va sospirar.

sentences.text: 他说：“不会写吧？我告诉你，茴字有四种写法，你知道吗？”

translation.en: He said, "You don't know how to write it, do you? Let me tell you, the character 'hui' has four ways of writing. Do you know that?"
translation.fr: He said, "You don't know how to write it, right? Let me tell you, the character 'hui' has four ways of writing. Do you know that?"
translation.es: He said, "You don't know how to write it, right? Let me tell you, the character 'hui' has four ways to write it. Do you know that?"
translation.pt: He said: "You don't know how to write it, right? Let me tell you, the character 'hui' has four ways of writing, do you know?"
translation.it: He said: "You don't know how to write it, right? Let me tell you, the character 'hui' has four ways of writing. Do you know that?"
translation.zh-Hans: 他说：“不会写吧？我告诉你，茴字有四种写法，你知道吗？”
translation.zh-Hant: 他說：「不會寫吧？我告訴你，茴字有四種寫法，你知道嗎？」
translation.ro: El spune: „Nu știi să-l scrii, nu-i așa? Îți spun eu: caracterul „hui” are patru moduri de scriere. Știi tu?”
translation.ca: Va dir: "No saps escriure'l, oi? T'ho diré, el caràcter 'hui' té quatre maneres d'escriure's, ho sabies?"

sentences.text: 我仍然没有回答，觉得这些知识对我根本没有用处。

translation.en: I still didn't answer, feeling that this knowledge was completely useless to me.
translation.fr: I still did not answer, feeling that this knowledge was completely useless to me.
translation.es: I still didn't answer, feeling that this knowledge was useless to me.
translation.pt: I still didn't answer, feeling that this knowledge was completely useless to me.
translation.it: I still didn't answer, feeling that this knowledge was useless to me.
translation.zh-Hans: 我仍然没有回答，觉得这些知识对我根本没有用处。
translation.zh-Hant: 我仍然沒有回答，覺得這些知識對我根本沒有用處。
translation.ro: Tot nu răspund, considerând că aceste cunoștințe nu-mi sunt de niciun folos.
translation.ca: Jo encara no vaig respondre, pensant que aquests coneixements no em servien de res.

sentences.text: 孔乙己见我不热心，脸上露出很失望的样子。

translation.en: Seeing that I wasn't enthusiastic, Kong Yiji showed a disappointed expression.
translation.fr: Seeing that I was not enthusiastic, Kong Yiji showed a disappointed expression.
translation.es: Seeing that I wasn't enthusiastic, Kong Yiji showed a disappointed expression.
translation.pt: Seeing that I wasn't enthusiastic, 孔乙己 showed a disappointed expression.
translation.it: Seeing that I wasn't enthusiastic, Kong Yiji showed a disappointed expression.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己见我不热心，脸上露出很失望的样子。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己見我不熱心，臉上露出很失望的樣子。
translation.ro: Văzând că nu sunt interesat, 孔乙己 arată o expresie dezamăgită.
translation.ca: Quan Kong Yiji va veure que no m'interessava, la seva cara va mostrar una expressió de decepció.

sentences.text: 柜台外面几个孩子听见笑声，也跑过来看热闹。

translation.en: Several children outside the counter heard the laughter and ran over to watch the excitement.
translation.fr: Several children outside the counter heard the laughter and ran over to watch the excitement.
translation.es: Several children outside the counter heard the laughter and ran over to watch the excitement.
translation.pt: Several children outside the counter heard the laughter and also ran over to watch the excitement.
translation.it: Several children outside the counter heard the laughter and ran over to watch the excitement.
translation.zh-Hans: 柜台外面几个孩子听见笑声，也跑过来看热闹。
translation.zh-Hant: 櫃台外面幾個孩子聽見笑聲，也跑過來看熱鬧。
translation.ro: Câțiva copii din afara tejghelei aud râsul și aleargă să vadă ce se întâmplă.
translation.ca: Uns quants nens de fora del taulell, en sentir les rialles, també van córrer a veure què passava.

sentences.text: 孔乙己看见孩子们，露出难得的笑容，显得很高兴。

translation.en: When Kong Yiji saw the children, he showed a rare smile and looked very happy.
translation.fr: When Kong Yiji saw the children, he showed a rare smile and looked very happy.
translation.es: When Kong Yiji saw the children, he showed a rare smile and looked very happy.
translation.pt: When 孔乙己 saw the children, he showed a rare smile, looking very happy.
translation.it: When Kong Yiji saw the children, he showed a rare smile and looked very happy.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己看见孩子们，露出难得的笑容，显得很高兴。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己看見孩子們，露出難得的笑容，顯得很高興。
translation.ro: Când îi vede pe copii, 孔乙己 zâmbește rar, părând foarte fericit.
translation.ca: Quan Kong Yiji va veure els nens, va mostrar un somriure poc habitual, semblava molt content.

sentences.text: 他把手里的茴香豆分给孩子们，一人一颗，自己却舍不得多吃。

translation.en: He distributed the fennel beans in his hand to the children, one each, but he himself was reluctant to eat more.
translation.fr: He distributed the fennel beans in his hand to the children, one each, but he himself was reluctant to eat more.
translation.es: He distributed the fennel beans in his hand to the children, one each, but he himself was reluctant to eat more.
translation.pt: He distributed the fennel beans in his hand to the children, one each, but he himself was reluctant to eat more.
translation.it: He distributed the fennel beans in his hand to the children, one each, but he himself was reluctant to eat more.
translation.zh-Hans: 他把手里的茴香豆分给孩子们，一人一颗，自己却舍不得多吃。
translation.zh-Hant: 他把手裡的茴香豆分給孩子們，一人一顆，自己卻捨不得多吃。
translation.ro: El împarte anasonul din mână copiilor, câte unul fiecăruia, dar el însuși nu se îndură să mănânce mai mult.
translation.ca: Va repartir els pèsols d'anís que tenia a la mà entre els nens, un per a cadascun, però ell mateix no en volia menjar més.

sentences.text: 孩子们吃完还不肯走，围着他，眼睛盯着碟子里剩下的豆子。

translation.en: After eating, the children still wouldn't leave. They surrounded him, eyes fixed on the remaining beans in the dish.
translation.fr: The children, after eating, still refused to leave, surrounding him, their eyes fixed on the remaining beans in the dish.
translation.es: Los niños, después de comer, no querían irse; lo rodeaban, con los ojos fijos en los frijoles que quedaban en el plato.
translation.pt: As crianças, depois de comer, ainda não queriam ir embora, cercavam-no, com os olhos fixos nos feijões restantes no prato.
translation.it: I bambini, dopo aver mangiato, non volevano andarsene, lo circondavano, con gli occhi fissi sui fagioli rimasti nel piatto.
translation.zh-Hans: 孩子们吃完还不肯走，围着他，眼睛盯着碟子里剩下的豆子。
translation.zh-Hant: 孩子們吃完還不肯走，圍著他，眼睛盯著碟子裡剩下的豆子。
translation.ro: Copiii, după ce au terminat de mâncat, nu voiau să plece, îl înconjurau, cu ochii ațintiți asupra boabelor rămase în farfurie.
translation.ca: Els nens, després de menjar, no volien marxar, el voltaven, amb els ulls fixats en les mongetes que quedaven al plat.

sentences.text: 孔乙己着急地说：“不多了，我已经不多了。”

translation.en: Kong Yiji said anxiously, "Not many left, I don't have many left."
translation.fr: Kong Yiji said anxiously, "Not many left, I already don't have many."
translation.es: Kong Yiji dijo apurado: "No hay muchos, ya no me quedan muchos."
translation.pt: Kong Yiji disse apressadamente: "Não há muitos, já não tenho muitos."
translation.it: Kong Yiji disse con ansia: "Non ce ne sono molti, non ne ho più molti."
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己着急地说：“不多了，我已经不多了。”
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己著急地說：「不多了，我已經不多了。」
translation.ro: Kong Yiji a spus grăbit: „Nu mai sunt multe, deja nu mai am multe.”
translation.ca: Kong Yiji va dir amb pressa: "No en queden gaires, ja no en tinc gaires."

sentences.text: 他用手捂住碟子，弯下腰说：“多乎哉？不多也。”

translation.en: He covered the dish with his hand, bent down, and said, "How many? Not many."
translation.fr: He covered the dish with his hand, bent over, and said, "Many? Not many."
translation.es: Cubrió el plato con la mano y, inclinándose, dijo: "¿Mucho? No mucho."
translation.pt: Ele cobriu o prato com a mão, curvou-se e disse: "Muito? Não muito."
translation.it: Coprì il piatto con la mano, si chinò e disse: "Molti? Non molti."
translation.zh-Hans: 他用手捂住碟子，弯下腰说：“多乎哉？不多也。”
translation.zh-Hant: 他用手捂住碟子，彎下腰說：「多乎哉？不多也。」
translation.ro: Și-a acoperit farfuria cu mâna, s-a aplecat și a zis: „Multe? Nu prea multe.”
translation.ca: Va tapar el plat amb la mà, es va inclinar i va dir: "N'hi ha moltes? No gaires."

sentences.text: 孩子们听不懂这句话，只是笑着一哄而散。

translation.en: The children didn't understand this sentence, they just laughed and scattered.
translation.fr: The children didn't understand this sentence, just laughed and scattered.
translation.es: Los niños no entendieron esta frase, solo rieron y se dispersaron.
translation.pt: As crianças não entenderam essa frase, apenas riram e se dispersaram.
translation.it: I bambini non capirono questa frase, e ridendo si dispersero in fretta.
translation.zh-Hans: 孩子们听不懂这句话，只是笑着一哄而散。
translation.zh-Hant: 孩子們聽不懂這句話，只是笑着一哄而散。
translation.ro: Copiii nu au înțeles vorbele lui, doar au râs și s-au împrăștiat.
translation.ca: Els nens no van entendre aquesta frase, només van riure i es van escampar.

sentences.text: 除了茴香豆，孔乙己还常常欠酒店的钱，从不按时还清。

translation.en: Besides fennel beans, Kong Yiji often owed money to the tavern and never paid it back on time.
translation.fr: Besides fennel beans, Kong Yiji often owed money to the tavern and never paid it back on time.
translation.es: Además de los frijoles de anís, Kong Yiji a menudo debía dinero en la taberna y nunca lo pagaba a tiempo.
translation.pt: Além dos feijões de erva-doce, Kong Yiji frequentemente devia dinheiro ao bar, nunca pagando em dia.
translation.it: Oltre ai fagioli all'anice, Kong Yiji era spesso in debito con la taverna, e non pagava mai in tempo.
translation.zh-Hans: 除了茴香豆，孔乙己还常常欠酒店的钱，从不按时还清。
translation.zh-Hant: 除了茴香豆，孔乙己還常常欠酒店的錢，從不按時還清。
translation.ro: Pe lângă boabele de anason, Kong Yiji mai datora adesea bani la crâșmă, fără să plătească la timp.
translation.ca: A més de les mongetes d'anís, Kong Yiji sovint devia diners a la taverna i mai no els tornava a temps.

sentences.text: 孔乙己虽然穷困，但写得一手好字，曾经替人抄书为生。

translation.en: Although Kong Yiji was poor, he wrote a good hand and once made a living copying manuscripts for others.
translation.fr: Although Kong Yiji was poor, he wrote a good hand and once made a living copying manuscripts for others.
translation.es: Aunque Kong Yiji era pobre, escribía muy bien y solía ganarse la vida copiando libros para otros.
translation.pt: Embora Kong Yiji fosse pobre, ele escrevia muito bem, e já ganhara a vida copiando livros para outros.
translation.it: Sebbene Kong Yiji fosse povero, scriveva molto bene, e un tempo viveva copiando libri per gli altri.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己虽然穷困，但写得一手好字，曾经替人抄书为生。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己雖然窮困，但寫得一手好字，曾經替人抄書為生。
translation.ro: Deși Kong Yiji era sărac, scria foarte frumos și cândva își câștiga existența copiind cărți pentru alții.
translation.ca: Tot i que Kong Yiji era pobre, escrivia molt bé i s'havia guanyat la vida copiant llibres per a altres.

sentences.text: 可惜他还有一个坏习惯，喜欢喝酒，又懒得做长久的工作。

translation.en: Unfortunately, he also had a bad habit: he liked drinking and was too lazy to do long-term work.
translation.fr: Unfortunately, he also had a bad habit: he liked drinking and was too lazy to do long-term work.
translation.es: Lamentablemente, también tenía un mal hábito: le gustaba beber y era perezoso para trabajos de larga duración.
translation.pt: Infelizmente, ele também tinha um mau hábito: gostava de beber e era preguiçoso para trabalhos de longo prazo.
translation.it: Purtroppo aveva anche un brutto vizio: amava bere e non gli piaceva fare lavori a lungo termine.
translation.zh-Hans: 可惜他还有一个坏习惯，喜欢喝酒，又懒得做长久的工作。
translation.zh-Hant: 可惜他還有個壞習慣，喜歡喝酒，又懶得做長久的工作。
translation.ro: Din păcate, mai avea un obicei prost: îi plăcea să bea și lenevea să muncească pe termen lung.
translation.ca: Però tenia un mal hàbit: li agradava beure i era mandrós per fer feines de llarga durada.

sentences.text: 抄书的人家渐渐发现，纸笔和书本常常跟着他一起消失。

translation.en: The people who hired him to copy gradually discovered that paper, brushes, and books often disappeared along with him.
translation.fr: The families who hired him to copy gradually discovered that paper, brushes, and books often disappeared along with him.
translation.es: Las familias que le encargaban copias poco a poco descubrieron que el papel, los pinceles y los libros solían desaparecer junto con él.
translation.pt: As pessoas que o contratavam para copiar gradualmente descobriram que papel, pincéis e livros frequentemente desapareciam junto com ele.
translation.it: Le persone che gli commissionavano copie scoprirono gradualmente che carta, penne e libri spesso scomparivano insieme a lui.
translation.zh-Hans: 抄书的人家渐渐发现，纸笔和书本常常跟着他一起消失。
translation.zh-Hant: 抄書的人家漸漸發現，紙筆和書本常常跟著他一起消失。
translation.ro: Oamenii pentru care copia au descoperit treptat că hârtia, pensulele și cărțile dispăreau adesea odată cu el.
translation.ca: La gent que li encarregava còpies va descobrir a poc a poc que el paper, els pinzells i els llibres sovint desapareixien juntament amb ell.

sentences.text: 没有人再敢雇他抄书，他的生活也因此越来越艰难。

translation.en: No one dared to hire him to copy anymore, and his life became more and more difficult because of this.
translation.fr: No one dared to hire him to copy anymore, and his life became increasingly difficult because of this.
translation.es: Nadie se atrevía a contratarlo para copiar, y su vida se volvió cada vez más difícil.
translation.pt: Ninguém mais ousava contratá-lo para copiar, e sua vida tornou-se cada vez mais difícil por causa disso.
translation.it: Nessuno osò più assumerlo per copiare, e la sua vita divenne sempre più difficile.
translation.zh-Hans: 没有人再敢雇他抄书，他的生活也因此越来越艰难。
translation.zh-Hant: 沒有人再敢僱他抄書，他的生活也因此越來越艱難。
translation.ro: Nimeni nu a mai îndrăznit să-l angajeze să copieze, iar viața lui a devenit din ce în ce mai grea.
translation.ca: Ningú gosava tornar a contractar-lo per copiar, i la seva vida es va fer cada cop més difícil.

sentences.text: 没有生计的时候，他只好偶尔做些偷窃的事情来维持生活。

translation.en: When he had no livelihood, he had to occasionally do some stealing to maintain his life.
translation.fr: When he had no livelihood, he had to occasionally do some stealing to maintain his life.
translation.es: Cuando no tenía cómo ganarse la vida, a veces recurría a pequeños robos para mantenerse.
translation.pt: Quando não tinha como ganhar a vida, ele ocasionalmente recorria a pequenos furtos para se sustentar.
translation.it: Quando non aveva mezzi di sostentamento, doveva occasionalmente rubare per sopravvivere.
translation.zh-Hans: 没有生计的时候，他只好偶尔做些偷窃的事情来维持生活。
translation.zh-Hant: 沒有生計的時候，他只好偶爾做些偷竊的事情來維持生活。
translation.ro: Când nu avea de lucru, recurgea uneori la furturi mărunte ca să se întrețină.
translation.ca: Quan no tenia feina, de tant en tant havia de fer algun robatori per mantenir-se.

sentences.text: 这也是为什么每次他一来，大家总喜欢问他偷东西的事。

translation.en: This is also why every time he came, everyone always liked to ask him about stealing things.
translation.fr: This is also why every time he came, everyone always liked to ask him about stealing things.
translation.es: Por eso, cada vez que venía, a todos les gustaba preguntarle sobre sus robos.
translation.pt: É por isso que, toda vez que ele vinha, todos gostavam de perguntar sobre seus furtos.
translation.it: Questo è anche il motivo per cui ogni volta che arrivava, tutti amavano chiedergli del furto.
translation.zh-Hans: 这也是为什么每次他一来，大家总喜欢问他偷东西的事。
translation.zh-Hant: 這也是為什麼每次他來，大家總喜歡問他偷東西的事。
translation.ro: De aceea, de fiecare dată când venea, tuturor le plăcea să-l întrebe despre furturi.
translation.ca: Per això, cada vegada que venia, tothom li preguntava sobre els robatoris.

sentences.text: 孔乙己从不肯承认自己做错，总要为自己辩解几句。

translation.en: Kong Yiji never admitted that he had done wrong; he always wanted to defend himself with a few words.
translation.fr: Kong Yiji never admitted his mistakes and always tried to defend himself with a few words.
translation.es: Kong Yiji nunca admitía haber hecho algo mal y siempre intentaba justificarse.
translation.pt: Kong Yiji nunca admitia ter feito algo errado; sempre tentava se justificar.
translation.it: Kong Yiji non ammetteva mai di aver sbagliato, e cercava sempre di giustificarsi.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己从不肯承认自己做错，总要为自己辩解几句。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己從不肯承認自己做錯，總要為自己辯解幾句。
translation.ro: Kong Yiji nu recunoștea niciodată că a greșit și totdeauna încerca să se justifice.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji mai no admetia haver fet res malament, sempre intentava justificar-se.

sentences.text: 可是他辩解的话，大家从来都不认真去听，只当作笑话。

translation.en: But people never listened seriously to his excuses; they only treated them as jokes.
translation.fr: But people never listened seriously to his excuses, only treated them as jokes.
translation.es: Pero sus excusas, nadie las escuchaba en serio, solo las tomaban como chiste.
translation.pt: Mas ninguém nunca levava a sério suas justificativas, apenas as tratavam como piada.
translation.it: Ma le sue scuse, nessuno le ascoltava mai seriamente, le prendevano solo come uno scherzo.
translation.zh-Hans: 可是他辩解的话，大家从来都不认真去听，只当作笑话。
translation.zh-Hant: 可是他辯解的話，大家從來都不認真去聽，只當作笑話。
translation.ro: Dar nimeni nu-l asculta cu adevărat când se justifica, ci doar îl luau în râs.
translation.ca: Però les seves excuses, ningú no les escoltava seriosament, només les prenien com una broma.

sentences.text: 掌柜每次看到他，总要提一提他欠的十九个钱。

translation.en: Every time the boss saw him, he always mentioned the nineteen coins he owed.
translation.fr: Every time the shopkeeper saw him, he always brought up the nineteen coins he owed.
translation.es: Cada vez que el dueño lo veía, siempre mencionaba los diecinueve centavos que debía.
translation.pt: Toda vez que o gerente o via, sempre mencionava os dezenove centavos que ele devia.
translation.it: Ogni volta che il proprietario lo vedeva, menzionava sempre i diciannove soldi che doveva.
translation.zh-Hans: 掌柜每次看到他，总要提一提他欠的十九个钱。
translation.zh-Hant: 掌櫃每次看到他，總要提一提他欠的十九個錢。
translation.ro: De fiecare dată când îl vedea, patronul aducea vorba despre cei nouăsprezece bani datorați.
translation.ca: Cada vegada que el veia, el propietari sempre li recordava els dinou diners que devia.

sentences.text: 孔乙己听了，总是脸上带着窘迫，低声说下次一定还清。

translation.en: When Kong Yiji heard this, he always looked embarrassed and said in a low voice that he would pay it back next time.
translation.fr: Hearing this, Kong Yiji always looked embarrassed and said in a low voice that he would pay it back next time.
translation.es: Kong Yiji, al oírlo, siempre se ponía apurado y decía en voz baja que la próxima vez pagaría todo.
translation.pt: Ao ouvir isso, Kong Yiji sempre ficava envergonhado e dizia em voz baixa que pagaria na próxima vez.
translation.it: Kong Yiji, sentendo ciò, mostrava sempre imbarazzo sul viso e diceva a bassa voce che la prossima volta avrebbe pagato tutto.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己听了，总是脸上带着窘迫，低声说下次一定还清。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己聽了，總是臉上帶著窘迫，低聲說下次一定還清。
translation.ro: Kong Yiji, auzind, avea o expresie stânjenită și spunea cu voce scăzută că data viitoare va plăti negreșit.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji, en sentir-ho, sempre posava cara d'angoixa i deia en veu baixa que la propera vegada ho pagaria tot.

sentences.text: 不过他每次来喝酒，还是照样赊账，从不例外。

translation.en: But every time he came to drink, he still ran up a tab as usual, never an exception.
translation.fr: But every time he came to drink, he still ran up a tab as usual, never an exception.
translation.es: Pero cada vez que venía a beber, seguía fiando como siempre, sin excepción.
translation.pt: Mas toda vez que vinha beber, ele continuava a comprar fiado, sem exceção.
translation.it: Ma ogni volta che veniva a bere, continuava a comprare a credito, senza eccezioni.
translation.zh-Hans: 不过他每次来喝酒，还是照样赊账，从不例外。
translation.zh-Hant: 不過他每次來喝酒，還是照樣賒帳，從不例外。
translation.ro: Dar de fiecare dată când venea să bea, tot pe datorie lua, fără excepție.
translation.ca: Però cada vegada que venia a beure, seguia demanant crèdit, sense excepció.

sentences.text: 渐渐地，来喝酒的人们都习惯了嘲笑他，习惯了他的存在。

translation.en: Gradually, the people who came to drink got used to mocking him and used to his presence.
translation.fr: Gradually, the people who came to drink got used to mocking him and used to his presence.
translation.es: Poco a poco, los clientes de la taberna se acostumbraron a burlarse de él y a su presencia.
translation.pt: Aos poucos, as pessoas que vinham beber se acostumaram a zombar dele e se acostumaram com sua presença.
translation.it: A poco a poco, le persone che venivano a bere si abituarono a deriderlo e alla sua presenza.
translation.zh-Hans: 渐渐地，来喝酒的人们都习惯了嘲笑他，习惯了他的存在。
translation.zh-Hant: 漸漸地，來喝酒的人們都習慣了嘲笑他，習慣了他的存在。
translation.ro: Treptat, oamenii care veneau să bea s-au obișnuit să râdă de el și să-i accepte prezența.
translation.ca: A poc a poc, la gent que venia a beure es va acostumar a riure's d'ell i a la seva presència.

sentences.text: 如果有一天他忽然不来了，大家似乎也不会太在意。

translation.en: If one day he suddenly didn't come, it seemed no one would care too much.
translation.fr: If one day he suddenly didn't come, everyone probably wouldn't care too much.
translation.es: Si un día de repente no venía, parecía que a nadie le importaba mucho.
translation.pt: Se um dia ele de repente não aparecesse, ninguém parecia se importar muito.
translation.it: Se un giorno improvvisamente non fosse venuto, nessuno sembrava preoccuparsene troppo.
translation.zh-Hans: 如果有一天他忽然不来了，大家似乎也不会太在意。
translation.zh-Hant: 如果有一天他忽然不來了，大家似乎也不會太在意。
translation.ro: Dacă într-o zi nu mai venea, probabil că nimeni nu și-ar fi bătut capul.
translation.ca: Si un dia deixés de venir de sobte, probablement ningú no se'n preocuparia gaire.

chapters.title: 第三章 最后一次来喝酒

sentences.text: 孔乙己有一段时间没有来咸亨酒店了，掌柜也没有在意。

translation.en: Kong Yiji hadn't come to the Xianheng Tavern for a while, and the boss didn't pay attention.
translation.fr: Kong Yiji hadn't come to the Xianheng Tavern for a while, and the shopkeeper didn't mind.
translation.es: Kong Yiji no había ido a la taberna Xianheng por un tiempo, y el dueño no le dio importancia.
translation.pt: Kong Yiji não aparecia no bar Xianheng há um tempo, e o gerente não se importou.
translation.it: Kong Yiji non venne alla taverna Xianheng per un po' di tempo, e il proprietario non ci fece caso.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己有一段时间没有来咸亨酒店了，掌柜也没有在意。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己有一段時間沒有來咸亨酒店了，掌櫃也沒有在意。
translation.ro: Kong Yiji nu a mai venit de ceva vreme la Taverna Xianheng, iar patronul nu a băgat de seamă.
translation.ca: Kong Yiji no havia anat a la taverna Xianheng durant un temps, i el propietari no hi havia parat atenció.

sentences.text: 中秋节前后，忽然有人说起孔乙己，说他又惹了大祸。

translation.en: Around the Mid-Autumn Festival, someone suddenly mentioned Kong Yiji, saying he had caused big trouble again.
translation.fr: Around the Mid-Autumn Festival, someone suddenly mentioned Kong Yiji, saying he had gotten into big trouble again.
translation.es: Alrededor del Festival del Medio Otoño, de repente alguien mencionó a Kong Yiji, diciendo que había causado un gran problema otra vez.
translation.pt: Por volta do Festival do Meio do Outono, de repente alguém falou de Kong Yiji, dizendo que ele tinha se metido em uma grande encrenca.
translation.it: Verso la festa di metà autunno, improvvisamente qualcuno parlò di Kong Yiji, dicendo che aveva causato un grosso guaio.
translation.zh-Hans: 中秋节前后，忽然有人说起孔乙己，说他又惹了大祸。
translation.zh-Hant: 中秋節前後，忽然有人說起孔乙己，說他又惹了大禍。
translation.ro: În preajma Festivalului de Mijlocul Toamnei, cineva a pomenit de Kong Yiji, spunând că a mai făcut o poznă mare.
translation.ca: Cap a la festa del Mig Tardor, de sobte algú va parlar de Kong Yiji, dient que havia causat un gran problema.

sentences.text: 原来他因为生活困难，偷了城里丁举人家里的书。

translation.en: It turned out that because of financial difficulties, he had stolen books from the Ding family's house in town.
translation.fr: Il avait volé des livres dans la maison du lettré Ding chez lui parce qu'il avait des difficultés de vie.
translation.es: Resulta que, por dificultades económicas, había robado los libros de la casa del señor Ding, un erudito de la ciudad.
translation.pt: 原来他因为生活困难，偷了城里丁举人家里的书。
translation.it: Originariamente, a causa delle difficoltà economiche, aveva rubato i libri dalla casa del signor Ding, un uomo della città.
translation.zh-Hans: 原来他因为生活困难，偷了城里丁举人家里的书。
translation.zh-Hant: 原来他因为生活困难，偷了城里丁举人家里的书。
translation.ro: It turned out that because of financial difficulties, he had stolen books from the Ding family's house in town.
translation.ca: Originalment, perquè tenia dificultats econòmiques, havia robat els llibres de la casa del senyor Ding, el lletrat, a la ciutat.

sentences.text: 丁举人家里的人抓住他，把他打了大半夜，打断了他的腿。

translation.en: The people in the Ding family caught him, beat him for most of the night, and broke his legs.
translation.fr: Les gens de la maison du lettré Ding l'ont attrapé, l'ont battu pendant une grande partie de la nuit et lui ont cassé les jambes.
translation.es: La gente de la casa del señor Ding lo atrapó, lo golpearon durante gran parte de la noche y le rompieron las piernas.
translation.pt: 丁举人家里的人抓住他，把他打了大半夜，打断了他的腿。
translation.it: La gente della famiglia del signor Ding lo catturò, lo picchiò per gran parte della notte e gli ruppe le gambe.
translation.zh-Hans: 丁举人家里的人抓住他，把他打了大半夜，打断了他的腿。
translation.zh-Hant: 丁举人家里的人抓住他，把他打了大半夜，打断了他的腿。
translation.ro: The people of the Ding family caught him, beat him for most of the night, and broke his legs.
translation.ca: La gent de la casa del senyor Ding el va atrapar, el va colpejar durant mitja nit i li va trencar les cames.

sentences.text: 这件事情传开以后，掌柜提起孔乙己，脸上带着一点笑意。

translation.en: After this news spread, the掌柜 mentioned Kong Yiji with a slight smile on his face.
translation.fr: Quand cette affaire s'est répandue, le patron, en parlant de Kong Yiji, avait un peu de sourire sur le visage.
translation.es: Cuando esto se difundió, el dueño de la taberna mencionó a Kong Yiji con una sonrisa en el rostro.
translation.pt: 这件事情传开以后，掌柜提起孔乙己，脸上带着一点笑意。
translation.it: Dopo che la notizia si diffuse, il proprietario, menzionando Kong Yiji, aveva un po' di sorriso sul viso.
translation.zh-Hans: 这件事情传开以后，掌柜提起孔乙己，脸上带着一点笑意。
translation.zh-Hant: 这件事情传开以后，掌柜提起孔乙己，脸上带着一点笑意。
translation.ro: After this matter spread, the掌柜 mentioned Kong Yiji with a slight smile on his face.
translation.ca: Quan la notícia es va escampar, el botiguer, en parlar de Kong Yiji, tenia un somriure a la cara.

sentences.text: 大家都觉得，孔乙己这一次，恐怕再也站不起来了。

translation.en: Everyone felt that Kong Yiji, this time, probably would never be able to stand up again.
translation.fr: Tout le monde pensait que cette fois, Kong Yiji ne pourrait probablement plus jamais se lever.
translation.es: Todos pensaron que Kong Yiji, esta vez, probablemente nunca más podría ponerse de pie.
translation.pt: 大家都觉得，孔乙己这一次，恐怕再也站不起来了。
translation.it: Tutti pensavano che Kong Yiji, questa volta, probabilmente non sarebbe mai più stato in grado di alzarsi.
translation.zh-Hans: 大家都觉得，孔乙己这一次，恐怕再也站不起来了。
translation.zh-Hant: 大家都觉得，孔乙己这一次，恐怕再也站不起来了。
translation.ro: Everyone felt that Kong Yiji, this time, probably would never stand up again.
translation.ca: Tothom pensava que Kong Yiji, aquesta vegada, potser mai més no es podria posar dret.

sentences.text: 后来听人说，丁举人本来还想直接打死他，是邻居劝阻才留了他一条命。

translation.en: Later, I heard from others that Ding had originally wanted to beat him to death directly, but it was only because the neighbors dissuaded him that he spared Kong's life.
translation.fr: Plus tard, on a entendu dire que le lettré Ding avait d'abord voulu le tuer directement, mais que c'était grâce à l'intervention des voisins qu'il avait gardé la vie.
translation.es: Más tarde, se supo que el señor Ding originalmente quería matarlo directamente, pero fue gracias a la intercesión de los vecinos que le perdonaron la vida.
translation.pt: 后来听人说，丁举人本来还想直接打死他，是邻居劝阻才留了他一条命。
translation.it: Più tardi si sentì dire che il signor Ding aveva originariamente voluto picchiarlo a morte, ma fu solo grazie all'intercessione dei vicini che gli fu risparmiata la vita.
translation.zh-Hans: 后来听人说，丁举人本来还想直接打死他，是邻居劝阻才留了他一条命。
translation.zh-Hant: 后来听人说，丁举人本来还想直接打死他，是邻居劝阻才留了他一条命。
translation.ro: Later, people said that Ding had originally wanted to beat him to death directly, but it was only because of the neighbors' persuasion that his life was spared.
translation.ca: Més tard, vam sentir dir que el senyor Ding originalment volia matar-lo directament, però va ser gràcies a la intercessió dels veïns que va conservar la vida.

sentences.text: 孔乙己被打断腿之后，在家里躺了很长时间，没有钱去看大夫。

translation.en: After Kong Yiji's legs were broken, he lay at home for a long time, without money to see a doctor.
translation.fr: Après s'être fait casser les jambes, Kong Yiji est resté couché à la maison pendant très longtemps, sans argent pour voir un médecin.
translation.es: Después de que le rompieron las piernas, Kong Yiji permaneció en cama durante mucho tiempo, sin dinero para ver a un médico.
translation.pt: 孔乙己被打断腿之后，在家里躺了很长时间，没有钱去看大夫。
translation.it: Dopo che gli furono rotte le gambe, Kong Yiji rimase a letto per molto tempo, senza soldi per vedere un medico.
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己被打断腿之后，在家里躺了很长时间，没有钱去看大夫。
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己被打断腿之后，在家里躺了很长时间，没有钱去看大夫。
translation.ro: After Kong Yiji's legs were broken, he lay at home for a long time, without money to see a doctor.
translation.ca: Després de tenir les cames trencades, Kong Yiji va estar estirat a casa durant molt de temps, sense diners per anar al metge.

sentences.text: 他靠着邻居偶尔送来的一点米粥，才勉强撑了下来。

translation.en: He relied on the occasional bowl of rice porridge that neighbors brought, barely managing to survive.
translation.fr: Il s'accrochait à peine grâce à un peu de bouillie de riz que les voisins lui apportaient de temps en temps.
translation.es: Sobrevivió apenas gracias a un poco de gachas de arroz que los vecinos le traían de vez en cuando.
translation.pt: 他靠着邻居偶尔送来的一点米粥，才勉强撑了下来。
translation.it: Si affidò al porridge di riso che i vicini occasionalmente gli portavano, riuscendo a malapena a sopravvivere.
translation.zh-Hans: 他靠着邻居偶尔送来的一点米粥，才勉强撑了下来。
translation.zh-Hant: 他靠着邻居偶尔送来的一点米粥，才勉强撑了下来。
translation.ro: He barely managed to survive by relying on the occasional rice porridge that neighbors brought.
translation.ca: Es va mantenir amb prou feines gràcies a una mica de farinetes d'arròs que els veïns li portaven de tant en tant.

sentences.text: 初冬的一个傍晚，我正在柜台里忙碌，忽然听见有人喊：“温一碗酒。”

translation.en: One early winter evening, I was busy behind the counter when I suddenly heard someone shout: "Warm a bowl of wine."
translation.fr: Un soir au début de l'hiver, j'étais occupé derrière le comptoir quand j'ai soudain entendu quelqu'un crier : "Chauffez un bol de vin."
translation.es: Una tarde a principios del invierno, estaba ocupado detrás del mostrador cuando de repente oí a alguien gritar: "Calienta un tazón de vino."
translation.pt: 初冬的一个傍晚，我正在柜台里忙碌，忽然听见有人喊：“温一碗酒。”
translation.it: Una sera all'inizio dell'inverno, mentre ero occupato dietro il bancone, improvvisamente sentii qualcuno chiamare: "Scalda una ciotola di vino."
translation.zh-Hans: 初冬的一个傍晚，我正在柜台里忙碌，忽然听见有人喊：“温一碗酒。”
translation.zh-Hant: 初冬的一个傍晚，我正在柜台里忙碌，忽然听见有人喊：“温一碗酒。”
translation.ro: One early winter evening, I was busy behind the counter when I suddenly heard someone shout: "Warm a bowl of wine."
translation.ca: Un capvespre a principis d'hivern, estava ocupat darrere del taulell quan de sobte vaig sentir algú que cridava: "Escalfa'm un bol de vi."

sentences.text: 声音低哑，我抬头一看，是孔乙己，可是他的样子完全变了。

translation.en: The voice was low and hoarse. I looked up and saw it was Kong Yiji, but his appearance had completely changed.
translation.fr: La voix était basse et rauque. J'ai levé la tête et j'ai vu que c'était Kong Yiji, mais son apparence avait complètement changé.
translation.es: La voz era ronca y baja. Levanté la vista y vi a Kong Yiji, pero su apariencia había cambiado por completo.
translation.pt: 声音低哑，我抬头一看，是孔乙己，可是他的样子完全变了。
translation.it: La voce era bassa e rauca. Alzai lo sguardo e vidi che era Kong Yiji, ma il suo aspetto era completamente cambiato.
translation.zh-Hans: 声音低哑，我抬头一看，是孔乙己，可是他的样子完全变了。
translation.zh-Hant: 声音低哑，我抬头一看，是孔乙己，可是他的样子完全变了。
translation.ro: The voice was low and hoarse. I looked up and saw it was Kong Yiji, but his appearance had completely changed.
translation.ca: La veu era ronca i apagada. Vaig aixecar el cap i vaig veure que era Kong Yiji, però el seu aspecte havia canviat completament.

sentences.text: 他的脸又黑又瘦，穿着一件破烂的夹袄，盘着两条腿。

translation.en: His face was dark and thin, he wore a tattered lined jacket, and his two legs were crossed.
translation.fr: Son visage était noir et maigre, il portait une veste ouatée en lambeaux et il avait les jambes croisées.
translation.es: Su rostro estaba oscuro y delgado, vestía una chaqueta acolchada rota y tenía las piernas cruzadas.
translation.pt: 他的脸又黑又瘦，穿着一件破烂的夹袄，盘着两条腿。
translation.it: Il suo viso era nero e magro, indossava una giacca rattoppata e teneva le gambe incrociate.
translation.zh-Hans: 他的脸又黑又瘦，穿着一件破烂的夹袄，盘着两条腿。
translation.zh-Hant: 他的脸又黑又瘦，穿着一件破烂的夹袄，盘着两条腿。
translation.ro: His face was black and thin, he wore a tattered lined jacket, and his two legs were crossed.
translation.ca: Tenia la cara negra i prima, duia una jaqueta esparracada i tenia les cames creuades.

sentences.text: 他的两条腿已经不能走路了，是用手撑着地面爬过来的。

translation.en: His legs could no longer walk; he had crawled over using his hands to support himself on the ground.
translation.fr: Ses deux jambes ne pouvaient plus marcher ; il était venu en rampant sur le sol avec ses mains.
translation.es: Ya no podía caminar con sus dos piernas; había llegado arrastrándose con las manos apoyadas en el suelo.
translation.pt: 他的两条腿已经不能走路了，是用手撑着地面爬过来的。
translation.it: Le sue gambe non potevano più camminare; era strisciato usando le mani per sostenersi sul terreno.
translation.zh-Hans: 他的两条腿已经不能走路了，是用手撑着地面爬过来的。
translation.zh-Hant: 他的两条腿已经不能走路了，是用手撑着地面爬过来的。
translation.ro: His legs could no longer walk; he had crawled over using his hands to support himself on the ground.
translation.ca: Les seves cames ja no podien caminar; s'havia arrossegat fins allà amb les mans.

sentences.text: 他从怀里摸出四文钱，放在我手里，让我给他温一碗酒。

translation.en: He took out four coppers from his bosom, placed them in my hand, and asked me to warm a bowl of wine for him.
translation.fr: Il sortit quatre pièces de monnaie de son sein, les mit dans ma main et me demanda de lui chauffer un bol de vin.
translation.es: Sacó cuatro monedas de cobre del pecho, las puso en mi mano y me pidió que le calentara un tazón de vino.
translation.pt: 他从怀里摸出四文钱，放在我手里，让我给他温一碗酒。
translation.it: Tirò fuori quattro monete di rame dal petto, le mise nella mia mano e mi chiese di scaldargli una ciotola di vino.
translation.zh-Hans: 他从怀里摸出四文钱，放在我手里，让我给他温一碗酒。
translation.zh-Hant: 他从怀里摸出四文钱，放在我手里，让我给他温一碗酒。
translation.ro: He took out four coppers from his bosom, placed them in my hand, and asked me to warm a bowl of wine for him.
translation.ca: Va treure quatre monedes de coure de la butxaca interior, me les va posar a la mà i em va demanar que li escalfés un bol de vi.

sentences.text: 掌柜看见他，还是照旧说：“孔乙己，你又欠十九个钱了！”

translation.en: The掌柜 saw him and still said as usual: "Kong Yiji, you owe nineteen coppers again!"
translation.fr: Le patron le vit et dit comme d'habitude : "Kong Yiji, tu me dois encore dix-neuf pièces !"
translation.es: El dueño de la taberna lo vio y, como siempre, dijo: "¡Kong Yiji, otra vez debes diecinueve monedas!"
translation.pt: 掌柜看见他，还是照旧说：“孔乙己，你又欠十九个钱了！”
translation.it: Il proprietario, vedendolo, disse ancora come al solito: "Kong Yiji, devi ancora diciannove soldi!"
translation.zh-Hans: 掌柜看见他，还是照旧说：“孔乙己，你又欠十九个钱了！”
translation.zh-Hant: 掌柜看见他，还是照旧说：“孔乙己，你又欠十九个钱了！”
translation.ro: The掌柜 saw him and still said as usual: "Kong Yiji, you owe nineteen coppers again!"
translation.ca: El botiguer, en veure'l, va dir com sempre: "Kong Yiji, tornes a deure dinou monedes!"

sentences.text: 孔乙己这次没有争辩，只是低声说：“这……下回还清。”

translation.en: This time Kong Yiji did not argue, only said in a low voice: "This... next time I'll pay it off."
translation.fr: Cette fois, Kong Yiji ne discuta pas, il dit seulement à voix basse : "Ce... je rembourserai la prochaine fois."
translation.es: Esta vez Kong Yiji no discutió, solo dijo en voz baja: "Esto... la próxima vez lo pagaré todo."
translation.pt: 孔乙己这次没有争辩，只是低声说：“这……下回还清。”
translation.it: Questa volta Kong Yiji non discusse, disse solo a bassa voce: "Questo... la prossima volta salderò il debito."
translation.zh-Hans: 孔乙己这次没有争辩，只是低声说：“这……下回还清。”
translation.zh-Hant: 孔乙己这次没有争辩，只是低声说：“这……下回还清。”
translation.ro: This time Kong Yiji did not argue, but only said in a low voice: "This... I'll pay it back next time."
translation.ca: Aquesta vegada Kong Yiji no va discutir, només va dir en veu baixa: "Això... ho pagaré la propera vegada."

sentences.text: 他喝完那碗酒，用手慢慢地撑着地面，一点一点地爬着离开。

translation.en: After he finished that bowl of wine, he slowly supported himself with his hands on the ground and crawled away bit by bit.
translation.fr: Après avoir fini son bol de vin, il s'appuya lentement sur ses mains pour ramper et partir petit à petit.
translation.es: Después de beber ese tazón de vino, lentamente se apoyó en el suelo con las manos y se alejó arrastrándose poco a poco.
translation.pt: 他喝完那碗酒，用手慢慢地撑着地面，一点一点地爬着离开。
translation.it: Dopo aver finito quella ciotola di vino, lentamente si sostenne con le mani sul terreno e se ne andò strisciando poco a poco.
translation.zh-Hans: 他喝完那碗酒，用手慢慢地撑着地面，一点一点地爬着离开。
translation.zh-Hant: 他喝完那碗酒，用手慢慢地撑着地面，一点一点地爬着离开。
translation.ro: After finishing that bowl of wine, he slowly supported himself with his hands on the ground and crawled away little by little.
translation.ca: Després de beure's el bol de vi, es va empènyer lentament amb les mans sobre el terra i va marxar arrossegant-se a poc a poc.

sentences.text: 从那以后，孔乙己再也没有到咸亨酒店来过。

translation.en: From then on, Kong Yiji never came to the Xianheng Tavern again.
translation.fr: Depuis ce jour-là, Kong Yiji n'est plus jamais venu à la taverne Xianheng.
translation.es: Desde entonces, Kong Yiji nunca más volvió a la taberna Xianheng.
translation.pt: 从那以后，孔乙己再也没有到咸亨酒店来过。
translation.it: Da allora, Kong Yiji non venne mai più alla taverna Xianheng.
translation.zh-Hans: 从那以后，孔乙己再也没有到咸亨酒店来过。
translation.zh-Hant: 从那以后，孔乙己再也没有到咸亨酒店来过。
translation.ro: From then on, Kong Yiji never came to the Xianheng Tavern again.
translation.ca: Des d'aleshores, Kong Yiji no va tornar mai més a la taverna Xianheng.

sentences.text: 我看着他爬着离开的背影，心里忽然觉得有点难过。

translation.en: Watching his crawling figure leave, I suddenly felt a little sad in my heart.
translation.fr: En le regardant s'éloigner en rampant, je me suis soudain senti un peu triste.
translation.es: Lo vi alejarse arrastrándose y, de repente, sentí un poco de tristeza en el corazón.
translation.pt: 我看着他爬着离开的背影，心里忽然觉得有点难过。
translation.it: Guardando la sua figura che strisciava via, improvvisamente provai un po' di tristezza nel cuore.
translation.zh-Hans: 我看着他爬着离开的背影，心里忽然觉得有点难过。
translation.zh-Hant: 我看着他爬着离开的背影，心里忽然觉得有点难过。
translation.ro: Watching his back as he crawled away, I suddenly felt a little sad in my heart.
translation.ca: Mentre el veia marxar arrossegant-se, vaig sentir una mica de tristesa al cor.

sentences.text: 这是我最后一次看见孔乙己，虽然当时我并不知道。

translation.en: That was the last time I saw Kong Yiji, although I didn't know it at the time.
translation.fr: C'était la dernière fois que je voyais Kong Yiji, même si je ne le savais pas à ce moment-là.
translation.es: Esa fue la última vez que vi a Kong Yiji, aunque en ese momento no lo sabía.
translation.pt: 这是我最后一次看见孔乙己，虽然当时我并不知道。
translation.it: Questa fu l'ultima volta che vidi Kong Yiji, anche se allora non lo sapevo.
translation.zh-Hans: 这是我最后一次看见孔乙己，虽然当时我并不知道。
translation.zh-Hant: 这是我最后一次看见孔乙己，虽然当时我并不知道。
translation.ro: This was the last time I saw Kong Yiji, although I did not know it at the time.
translation.ca: Va ser l'última vegada que vaig veure Kong Yiji, tot i que aleshores no ho sabia.

sentences.text: 咸亨酒店里的生活照常继续，客人来来往往，谁也不再提起他。

translation.en: Life at the Xianheng Tavern continued as usual, customers came and went, and no one mentioned him anymore.
translation.fr: La vie à la taverne Xianheng continua comme d'habitude, les clients allaient et venaient, et plus personne ne parlait de lui.
translation.es: La vida en la taberna Xianheng continuó como siempre, los clientes iban y venían, y nadie volvió a mencionarlo.
translation.pt: 咸亨酒店里的生活照常继续，客人来来往往，谁也不再提起他。
translation.it: La vita nella taverna Xianheng continuò come al solito, i clienti andavano e venivano, e nessuno lo menzionava più.
translation.zh-Hans: 咸亨酒店里的生活照常继续，客人来来往往，谁也不再提起他。
translation.zh-Hant: 咸亨酒店里的生活照常继续，客人来来往往，谁也不再提起他。
translation.ro: Life in the Xianheng Tavern continued as usual, customers came and went, and no one mentioned him anymore.
translation.ca: La vida a la taverna Xianheng va continuar com sempre, els clients anaven i venien, i ningú no el mencionava més.

sentences.text: 只有我，偶尔在温酒的时候，会想起他教我写茴字的样子。

translation.en: Only I, occasionally while warming wine, would think of the way he taught me to write the character 'hui'.
translation.fr: Seulement moi, parfois en chauffant le vin, je pensais à la façon dont il m'avait appris à écrire le caractère hui.
translation.es: Solo yo, de vez en cuando, al calentar vino, recordaba cómo me enseñaba a escribir el carácter 'hui'.
translation.pt: 只有我，偶尔在温酒的时候，会想起他教我写茴字的样子。
translation.it: Solo io, ogni tanto mentre scaldo il vino, ricordo come mi insegnava a scrivere il carattere 'hui'.
translation.zh-Hans: 只有我，偶尔在温酒的时候，会想起他教我写茴字的样子。
translation.zh-Hant: 只有我，偶尔在温酒的时候，会想起他教我写茴字的样子。
translation.ro: Only I, occasionally while warming wine, would think of the way he taught me to write the character 'hui'.
translation.ca: Només jo, de tant en tant, mentre escalfava vi, recordava com m'ensenyava a escriure el caràcter 'hui'.

sentences.text: 我也会想起他分给孩子们茴香豆时脸上难得的笑容。

translation.en: I would also remember the rare smile on his face when he distributed aniseed peas to the children.
translation.fr: Je me souviens aussi du sourire rare sur son visage quand il distribuait des fèves de soja aux enfants.
translation.es: También recuerdo la rara sonrisa en su rostro cuando repartía habas de anís a los niños.
translation.pt: Também me lembro do raro sorriso em seu rosto quando ele distribuía favas de anis às crianças.
translation.it: Anch'io ricordo il raro sorriso sul suo viso quando distribuiva i semi di soia fermentata ai bambini.
translation.zh-Hans: 我也会想起他分给孩子们茴香豆时脸上难得的笑容。
translation.zh-Hant: 我也会想起他分给孩子们茴香豆时脸上难得的笑容。
translation.ro: Îmi amintesc și de zâmbetul rar de pe fața lui când împărțea boabe de anason copiilor.
translation.ca: També recordaré el somriure rar que tenia a la cara quan repartia faves d'anís als nens.

sentences.text: 一个连秀才都没有考中的读书人，最终却因为偷书断了双腿。

translation.en: A scholar who had not even passed the county examination ended up with both legs broken because of stealing books.
translation.fr: Un lettré qui n'avait même pas réussi l'examen de licence, mais qui finalement a eu les jambes cassées pour avoir volé des livres.
translation.es: Un hombre letrado que ni siquiera había aprobado el examen de xiucai, al final perdió ambas piernas por robar libros.
translation.pt: Um estudioso que nem mesmo passou no exame imperial, mas acabou perdendo as duas pernas por roubar livros.
translation.it: Un uomo di lettere che non era nemmeno riuscito a superare l'esame di contea, alla fine si ruppe entrambe le gambe per aver rubato libri.
translation.zh-Hans: 一个连秀才都没有考中的读书人，最终却因为偷书断了双腿。
translation.zh-Hant: 一个连秀才都没有考中的读书人，最终却因为偷书断了双腿。
translation.ro: Un cărturar care nu reușise nici măcar să treacă examenul de licență a ajuns, în cele din urmă, să-și piardă picioarele din cauza furtului de cărți.
translation.ca: Un home lletrat que ni tan sols havia aprovat l'examen de xiucai, finalment va acabar amb les cames trencades per robar llibres.

sentences.text: 这样的结局，让人觉得可笑，却也让人觉得说不出的悲伤。

translation.en: Such an ending makes people feel ridiculous, yet also brings an indescribable sadness.
translation.fr: Une telle fin semble risible, mais elle inspire aussi une tristesse indicible.
translation.es: Un final así resulta ridículo, pero también provoca una tristeza indescriptible.
translation.pt: Um final assim faz as pessoas acharem engraçado, mas também traz uma tristeza indescritível.
translation.it: Un finale del genere fa ridere, ma allo stesso tempo provoca una tristezza indescrivibile.
translation.zh-Hans: 这样的结局，让人觉得可笑，却也让人觉得说不出的悲伤。
translation.zh-Hant: 这样的结局，让人觉得可笑，却也让人觉得说不出的悲伤。
translation.ro: Un asemenea deznodământ pare ridicol, dar și de o tristețe greu de exprimat.
